Prove symbolically that no remaining A/B vertex is adjacent to a_i or b_j and hence its list stays [2,3,4] or [1,3,4], while z is adjacent to both fixed pair vertices and therefore its exact list is [1,2,3,4]\{gamma,delta}.
Prove for gamma,delta in {3,4} that L_res(z) has size 3 if gamma=delta and size 2 if gamma!=delta; all leaf lists have size 3.
Prove the exact residual edge set is a star (or K1), hence acyclic, for all quantified parameters.
Bind O4/O5 to the already sealed T2_FOREST_LIST theorem without introducing a new coloring solver.
